name: TwoPin
description: Pinterest-style link boards: save URLs to boards; metadata (title, description, preview image, favicon) is fetched and stored server-side. See AGENTS.md.

endpoints.name: listBoards
endpoints.description: Lists the caller's workspace boards with pin counts, oldest first.

endpoints.name: createBoard
endpoints.description: Creates a board. `spaceId` is optional (boards can be workspace-wide).

endpoints.name: updateBoard
endpoints.description: Renames a board, edits its description, or moves it to a space. Only fields present are changed.

endpoints.name: deleteBoard
endpoints.description: Deletes a board and all its pins (cascade).

endpoints.name: listPins
endpoints.description: Lists pins in the workspace, newest first; pass `?boardId=` to scope to one board and `?tag=` to filter by a tag. Binary assets are never inlined — use hasImage/hasFavicon/hasMedia with the /pins/:id/{image,favicon,media} endpoints.

endpoints.name: getPin
endpoints.description: Fetches one pin.

endpoints.name: listTags
endpoints.description: Lists distinct pin tags in the workspace with counts, most-used first (for filter chips / suggestions).

endpoints.name: createPin
endpoints.description: Adds a pin to a board. Provide `url` to fetch its metadata server-side (Open Graph/Twitter Card/meta fallbacks; redirects followed; private IPs refused; the preview image and favicon are downloaded and stored so clients never hotlink), OR provide `mediaBase64` (image/* or video/*) for a direct media pin with no source link. Provide both to attach media to a link. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.

endpoints.name: updatePin
endpoints.description: Edits a pin: move boards, override title/description, edit the note, or change the URL. Changing the URL re-fetches metadata (overwriting title/description with fresh values).

endpoints.name: refreshPin
endpoints.description: Re-fetches a pin's metadata from its URL, overwriting title/description/image/favicon with fresh values.

endpoints.name: deletePin
endpoints.description: Removes a pin from its board (stored image/favicon go with it).

endpoints.name: pinImage
endpoints.description: Serves the pin's stored preview image bytes (content-type preserved, 24h private cache). 404 when none was fetched.

endpoints.name: pinFavicon
endpoints.description: Serves the pin's stored favicon bytes (content-type preserved, 24h private cache). 404 when none was fetched.

endpoints.name: pinMedia
endpoints.description: Serves the pin's directly-uploaded media bytes (image or video, content-type preserved, 24h private cache). 404 when none.

endpoints.name: uploadPinMedia
endpoints.description: Uploads or replaces a pin's media (image/* or video/*), base64 JSON body.

endpoints.name: previewMetadata
endpoints.description: Fetches a URL's metadata WITHOUT saving anything — powers the add-pin dialog's live preview. Images come back as base64 data URIs (byte-capped). 422 with {ok:false, error} when the URL can't be fetched.

endpoints.name: listBookmarkFolders
endpoints.description: Lists the caller's workspace bookmark folders with bookmark counts, oldest first.

endpoints.name: createBookmarkFolder
endpoints.description: Creates a bookmark folder; pass `parentId` to nest it under another folder.

endpoints.name: updateBookmarkFolder
endpoints.description: Renames a bookmark folder or moves it under another folder (`parentId`, null = top level).

endpoints.name: deleteBookmarkFolder
endpoints.description: Deletes a bookmark folder and all its bookmarks (cascade).

endpoints.name: listBookmarks
endpoints.description: Lists bookmarks, newest first. Pass `?folderId=<id>` for one folder or `?folderId=unfiled` for folderless bookmarks. Binary favicons are never inlined — use hasFavicon with /bookmarks/:id/favicon.

endpoints.name: createBookmark
endpoints.description: Saves a bookmark. Metadata (title, description, favicon) is fetched server-side best-effort; a missing scheme is assumed to be https://. `folderId` is optional (null = unfiled).

endpoints.name: updateBookmark
endpoints.description: Edits a bookmark: move folders, override title/description, or change the URL (re-fetches the favicon).

endpoints.name: deleteBookmark
endpoints.description: Removes a bookmark.

endpoints.name: bookmarkFavicon
endpoints.description: Serves the bookmark's stored favicon bytes (content-type preserved, 24h private cache). 404 when none was fetched.

endpoints.name: getSettings
endpoints.description: Returns the workspace's TwoPin settings (currently just the default board for the PWA share target).

endpoints.name: updateSettings
endpoints.description: Sets the workspace's TwoPin settings. `defaultBoardId` is the board shared links land in.

endpoints.name: shareSave
endpoints.description: Saves a shared URL straight into the workspace's configured default board (this is what the PWA share target posts to). Metadata is fetched server-side. Falls back to the first board, or a lazily-created 'Shared' board.
